# Stand Still, Two Rooms

Two rooms, one rule: stand still. I built it after reading about art games and new media, where everyone argues whether a game must be playable or only meaningful. I think it can be both, if you are bad at moving. Nothing scores. Nothing ends. The doorway between the rooms opens only when you stop. I tested it myself by standing very still in the workshop for four minutes. Nothing happened, which is the point, and also the bug.
